name: Free body
description: A point in space with a full pose and velocity. X, Y and Z position (m) and X, Y and Z velocity (m/s) are the states that matter. Roll, Pitch and Yaw (rad) are there for visualisers, and nothing in the library drives them. The node's own equations make each position change at the rate of its velocity, so a connected edge can act on a velocity (Rod X and Rod Y do) or on a position directly (Crank drive does). What it does depends only on what you connect: left alone it is a fixed pivot (set its starting position in the initial values); under Crank drive it circles a pivot; under Rod X and Rod Y it follows a neighbour at a fixed distance.
